title: Appleseed Audiobook MEG
description: This dataset comprises magnetoencephalography (MEG) recordings from 12 participants listening to continuous narrative speech (an audiobook), along with an empty-room recording, stimulus files, and derivatives. The dataset was collected to investigate whether speech processing relies on local, context-independent representations or unified predictive models that integrate sentence-level context, examining neural signatures at the phoneme and word levels. Source localization analyses implicate bilateral superior temporal regions in these parallel predictive processes.
methods_description: MEG data were recorded while participants listened to continuous narrative speech and were converted to BIDS format using MNE-BIDS with MNE-Python. MRI data are not subject-specific anatomical scans but are derived from the fsaverage template using subject-specific scaling parameters. Stimuli include audio, gammatone feature pickles, and Praat TextGrid annotations.
